description: Ministry of Water Supply - National Water Supply and Drainage Board Law No. 02 of 1974 - Notice Under Section 84-tariffs charged w.e.f 01.09.2022 ( Correction Notice Published on Extra Gazette No. 2299/59 of 29.09.2022)
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal notice under Section 84 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Law No. 02 of 1974, establishing new water tariffs and regulatory requirements. While it includes a minister's name, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing regulatory changes and tariff structures, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
